description.value:
A rifle that belonged to a cagey Raffen Shiv. Wasn't cagey enough, as it turns out.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic Sniper Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Marksman Rifle

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 10 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Tech Rebuild

Special Features: Can only load custom Improved Poison Ammunition (250eb [Expensive] per 10) that deals 4d6 Single Shot damage in addition to the the usual effect and possible damage of Poison Ammunition. When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 2 rounds in a burst. This weapon will not fire if there are less than 2 rounds in the magazine. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (5d6 Normal / 6d6 Charged). While this weapon’s Tech Rebuild is charged and the user is rolling for its non-Poison damage, it deals 1d6 additional damage (5d6 Normal / 6d6 Aimed).

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Marksman Rifle
Pre-installed: Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
